lanPorts.title: LAN ports
lanPorts.description: Manage LAN-side ports. WAN ports are managed on the Internet tab.

clients.title: DHCP Clients
clients.description: Interfaces on which this router acts as a DHCP client (WAN).
clients.sharedSubnet: {{interfaces}} share the {{prefix}}.x subnet. Change it on one upstream modem.
clients.empty: This router is not a DHCP client on any interface.

leases.title: DHCP Leases
leases.description: Active DHCP leases issued to clients on the LAN.

confirmRemove.title: Remove DHCP lease
confirmRemove.description: Remove the lease for {{address}} ({{mac}})? This cannot be undone.

confirmStatic.title: Make DHCP lease static
confirmStatic.description: Make the lease for {{address}} ({{mac}}) static? The client will keep this address.

toasts.cacheFailedDetail: Failed to clear the DNS cache.
toasts.familyPartial: {{message}} Some forwarders may already have been switched, so check the list before retrying.

dns.description: DNS servers configured on this router, grouped by domestic, foreign and VPN traffic.
dns.adBlockHint: Blocks ad and tracker domains for every device on the network.
dns.adBlockWarning: Some sites stop working while it is on.

confirmReset.title: Reset DNS settings?
confirmReset.description: Every DNS server, forwarder, failover route and netwatch probe returns to its default value. Custom DNS servers are discarded.

confirmEnableFamily.title: Enable Family DNS?
confirmEnableFamily.description: The Foreign and VPN forwarders switch to filtering servers.

confirmDisableFamily.title: Disable Family DNS?
confirmDisableFamily.description: The Foreign and VPN forwarders go back to their standard servers, and filtering stops.

static.title: Static DNS entries
static.description: Names the router answers with a fixed IPv4 address, for devices on your network.
static.loadFailed: Failed to load static DNS entries.

form.nameInvalid: Use up to 253 letters, digits, dots, hyphens, underscores or *.

toasts.addFailed: Failed to add static DNS entry
toasts.updateFailed: Failed to update static DNS entry
toasts.deleteFailed: Failed to delete static DNS entry

confirmDelete.title: Delete static DNS entry
confirmDelete.description: Remove "{{name}}" from this router? This cannot be undone.

dnsChange.title: Change DNS server
dnsChange.enterIp: Enter a new DNS server IP
dnsChange.notSuitable: {{ip}} is not suitable for the {{type}} DNS.
dnsChange.verifyFailedDetail: Failed to verify the new DNS server.
dnsChange.hintManual: Any reachable IP can be entered.
dnsChange.hintSelect: Turn on manual entry to type an IP that is not listed.

firewall.title: Firewall rules
firewall.description: Active filter rules on this router, ordered by priority.
firewall.emptyInChain: No firewall rules configured in the {{chain}} chain.

domestic.title: Domestic addresses
domestic.description: The DOMAddList address list holds the domestic IP ranges. The router keeps it up to date, and you can add your own addresses, which updates leave in place.
domestic.loadFailed: Failed to load the domestic address list.
domestic.blockHint: Drops traffic from your network and from the router itself to any address in the list.
domestic.blockPartial: Only some of the block rules are enabled on the router. Turn the switch on or off to set them all.
domestic.blockLoadFailed: Failed to load the domestic block status.

toasts.blockOn: Traffic to domestic addresses is blocked
toasts.blockOff: Traffic to domestic addresses is allowed
toasts.blockFailed: Failed to change the domestic block

confirmBlock.title: Block traffic to domestic addresses?
confirmBlock.description: Devices on your network and the router itself will not be able to reach any address in the domestic list until you turn this off.

confirmDelete.title: Delete domestic address
confirmDelete.description: Remove {{address}} from the domestic address list? This cannot be undone.

kindDescriptions.split: Splits traffic to foreign and domestic automatically for that interface.
kindDescriptions.domestic: Routes all traffic to domestic for that interface.
kindDescriptions.foreign: Routes all traffic to foreign for that interface.
kindDescriptions.vpn: Routes all traffic to VPN for that interface.

card.title: Bridge ports
card.description: Which bridge each LAN port belongs to, and therefore how its traffic is routed.
card.empty: No LAN bridge ports on this router.

dialog.restartWarning: {{interface}} restarts to apply this. You may lose the network or the internet for a few seconds.
